tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rin po che 'od gsal rang grol gyi rnam par thar pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/ de ltar ngo mtshar mchog gis brgyan pa/ phyam brdal rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang las skad gcig g.yel ba med cing padmo rgyas par mdzad pa'i bla ma dam pa/ sna tshogs rang grol chen po de nyid la/ kho bos 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don rnams phyin ci ma log par zhus te/ thos bsam sgom gsum dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis ci mnyes su bsgrubs te/ de'ang kho bo'i yul ni g.yu ru gzhung 'be zhes bya bar/ yab dpal mgon dar zhes bya ba dang*/ yum se mo zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs te/ chung ngu'i dus nas dad pa dang*/ nges 'byung skyo shas drag po thun mong ma yin pa skye ba zhig yod cing*/ lo dgu lon pa'i dus su/ a ne zhig gi go na bsdad pa'i dus su/ bya bral ba khyi lpags sked la dkris pa zha ི ga / nga smyo ba ni min/ 'bog pa ni min/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs zer ba zhig mthong ba tsam gyis nges 'byung skyes pas/ nga phyags phyir 'khrid par zhu zhus nas/ zla shas kyi bar phyi la 'brangs te/ thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs kyi skor rnams zhus nas yig drug bgrangs pas/ nyams sam rmi lam gyi snang ba la byin gyis rlabs snyam byed pa byung dus/ 'gro ba la byams pa dang*/ snying rje'i snang ba dpag tu med pa skyes/ gzhung gi phur/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la dge bsnyen dang yongs rdzogs zhus shing*/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po/ 'gro bzang*/ bde mchog lhan skyes rnams zhus nas bsnyen pa cung zad byas pas rtags rnams mtshon pa byung*/ de nas nyi shu rtsa lnga na zul phur phyin te/ mkhan chen zul phu ba dang*/ slob dpon shākya don grub gnyis las dge slong cha ི ga rdzogs zhus nas/ slob dpon shākya don grub las 'dul ba gzhi stong bslabs/ bla ma dam pa shākya shes rab las lhan cig skyes sbyor/ tilli pa'i brda'i chos bzhi/ gtum mo zhag bdun ma/ mi la'i gtum mo gzhung khrid/ ri chos skor gsum bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma bla ma sgrub pa/

dmus long sba sa pa mig 'byed kyi dbang rnams zhus nas/ zang zing gi yon 'bul rgyu med pas/ zla ba bdun gyi bar du sgrub pa'i mchod pa phul nas bsgoms pas/ sems spros bral gyi ngo bo mthong zhing*/ bla ma shin tu mnyes nas khyod kyis sems can la phan thogs pa zhig 'od bar 'dug gsung ste/ dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ de dus 'bru chen dang*/ bcud len than thun la brten cing*/ gos kyang khyi lpags re dang ber bo gcig la brten nas sgrub pa snying por byas shing*/ bla ma dam pa lha sar 'byor pa'i phyags phyi la phyin te/ chu 'thung zhus te chu dbyar gcig 'thungs pas snying rus che gsung nas shin tu thugs rjes bzung ste/ dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyes pas/ bla ma sprul pa'i skur 'dug snyam nas gsol ba btab pa/ kye kye mgon po sprul pa'i sku/ / bdag sogs rigs drug sems can rnams/ / thog mtha' med pa'i dus nyid du/ /nying 'khrul zo chu'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /bzod med sdug bsngal chas kyis brgyan/ / thar med yun ring mnar ba la/ / thugs rje'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ / chu bzang du bla ma dam pa grags pa bshes gnyen pa la/ rdzogs chen bla ma gzhungs nas brgyud pa/ ni gu chos drug chos skyong phyag drug pa/ mkha' spyod kyi skor rnams zhus/ tshe 'di'i dbang du ma gyur tsam pa'i 'dun pa byas shing*/ srin po ri ru slob dpon grags pa shes rab las phar phyin/ brtag gnyis/ rnam 'joms shol po lugs/ sa skya pa'i dpa' po gcig pa/ chos skyong ser nag rnams zhus/ kun rig gzhan phan rnam gzigs rnams bslabs shing lus ngag yid gsum sel med kyi sgo nas mos gus rnam par dag pa'i mchod pa phul/ bye rdzing pa'i mkhan po bsod she'i drung du ston pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug lung thob tsam dang*/ sgrol ma bcu bdun ma'i dbang las kha tshar dang bcas pa/ sman bla'i mdo chogarnam 'joms dpa' bo gcig pa/

sme brtsegs rnams zhus shing thugs rjes shin tu 'dzin par mdzad/ mkhan po a dge ba las bka' gdams lam rim/ blo sbyong gi dbang / zhi byed rma so kam gsum rnams dang*/ mgon po a gho ra'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa zhus/ lho brag shar du phyin te/ chos rje rgod tshang pa'i skye ba bla ma na lung pa'i drung du/ rgod tshang pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor/ khrid chen brgyad/ rten 'brel snying po rnams zhus nas zla ba bdun du nyams len rtse gcig tu byas te/ 'tsho ba yang skyo tsha phor re las med pa la gsol ba kho na btab cing*/ tshe 'di'i 'dun pa thongs par bya snyam pa'i zhe bcad drag tu skyes/ lho brag mkhar chur gnas skor la phyin te/ bla ma 'ga' zhig gi drung du chos 'brel tsam zhus/ lha mo nang du bla ma lha mo 'khar ba bya ba dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lhag bzhes pa'i drung du/ zla ba lnga bsdad nas zhi byed so skor dang*/ gzhan yang phan bya'i skor mang du zhus/ 'tsho ba yang rtag tu ngu'i ril bu tsho gcig la brten cing yul phyogs su mi log par/ bla ma'i drung 'di nyid du nyams len kho na la brtson par byed la/ tshe 'di'i 'dun ma la don med snyam pa rgyud la skyes shing*/ lhan cig 'dzom pa'i sgyu lus 'di yang nam bor cha med par 'dug snyam pa dang*/ gnyen nye du'i brtse gdung la yang rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i 'dun pa skyes shing gro bo lung du gnas skor la phyin te/ mar pa'i gdan sa bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang mjal/ nā ro'i chos drug zhus nas/ mi la phug par zla ba lnga tsam bsgom zhing*/ chos drug gi rtags dum pa byung bas/ bla ma mnyes nas lha khang sar pa'i dgon gzhi dang bcas khyod la ster ba yin/ gdan sa byed dgos gsung pa nan cher mdzad/ bdag 'dra'i spra nga po 'khyams pos gong ma'i gdan sa mi yong lags pas bka' bkyon mi gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ khyed dge sbyor la blo 'gro bar 'dug pa 'di la dka' las ci yang med pas gyis gsungs kyang*/

bka' gcog par mi 'os na 'ang*/ sku drin la dge sbyor ci nus byed par zhu zhus nas mi la phug par bsdad dus/ bya bral ba gnas skor la byung ba zhig dang 'phrad/ tsā ri'i lam yig rim pa gnyis tsam kho bo'i lag na 'dug pas/ de rnams la ltad mo byas dus/ tsā ri'i che ba'i yon tan dang bsngags pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dug pas/ skad cig la blo 'gyur nas/ tshe 'di blos btang nas ci nas kyang tsā ri la 'gro snyam pa'i bdun pa drag po skyes shing*/ de yang tsā ri'i gnas sgo lha sa nas 'byed dgos / bcu gcig zhal gyi drung du gsol ba 'debs dgos bya ba 'dug pas/ lha sar phyin te dkon gnyer la zhu ba byas nas gsol ba zhag 'gar btab dus/ rmi lam du mi dkar po shel gyi mdog lta bu gcig gis bdud rtsi'i ril bu yin zer ba sbyin pa rmis pas/ lus ngag yid gsum bde ba snyam byed cing*/ gnyid sad pa dang rtog pa dang bral ba'i bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams zhag gnyis kyi bar du byung zhing*/ de dus su skor ba dang gsol ba 'debs pa zhag 'ga' byas dus/ la stod rdor gling pa tsā rir 'byon pa dpon slob sum cu skor byung pa dang bsdongs nas phyin dus tsā ri'i rnying mar slebs te/ dgyer sgom zhig pos btab pa'i gnas rdza khrod nub bya bar bsdad nas/ g.yu mtsho bskor zhing lus ngal la stobs med par gyur kyang*/ mar rgan byas na sgrib pa 'dags pa'i stobs che zer bas mar rgan byas dus/ 'khos ka chung bas lus ngag la skyo dub cher byung yang bzod par byas shing*/ mos gus dang dag pa'i snang bas mched grogs rnams mnyes par byas pas/ mthong snang la sogs rab rib gsal ba rnams kyang rang sems dag pa'i rten 'brel kho nar 'dug snyam pa dang*/ re gong pa'i dbu mdzad bzang po gcig la ni gu chos drug dang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ byin rlabs can gyi nā ro pa'i rgyan drug thod pa mtshan ldan rnams a pho rdor 'dzin la g.yar po zhus te/

bka' dang bcas pa rdzogs par zhus nas nyams su blangs pas/ mi rgod gtum mo sgom dus ras thub tsam byung la/ sgyu lus bden med khong du chud/ /rmi lam 'dun pa'i yid dang bral/ /bar do'i zhing khams mngon du 'gyur/ /'pho ba 'pho byed rten dang bral/ /'gro drug skye sgo chod dam snyam/ /nges pa'i shes pa gting nas skyes/ / de dus lo gsum gyi dam bca' byas/ lung phran na bzhugs pa'i bla ma 'ga' zhig las chos 'brel zhus shing*/ lo gsum bsdad dus la bar skas mgo bya ba na/ yon bdag mo dad pa can rdor rgyan bya ba zhig gis/ rta rgod ma gcig phul ba la brten te/ lag na yod pa'i gtor cha dang chas rnams grogs mched gcig la 'tshong du bcug nas/ tsā ri ras pa brgyad brgya la tshogs kyi 'khor lo bsgrubs nas/ chags zhen gyi 'khri ba bcad/ zang zing rnams don yod par byas te/ lung phran 'ga' zhig tu chu 'thung zhing sgrub pa byas pas/ gegs chen po byung nas chu ra dang khar ma byung bar/ lus kyi nyams stobs rnams bri/ lta ba'i mig 'bral kyang khong du rdib cing yas bcibs mas bcibs gnyis la 'jag ma'i ka ba btsugs te byas/ smra ba'i lce yang mi 'gyur ba la/ lus rgud rtsib ma rgyu ma la zug /de dus bems rig bral bar gyur kyang 'gyod med ngang la nyal nas bsdad/ zhag bdun lon nas gegs sel te/ / 'thung chu 'o ma lta bur gyur/ / chu sgra thos dus bcud rnams lon pa snyam/ / lus kyang shing bal lta bur yang*/ / ming yang bla ma chu bar grags/ / de nas bzung ste grogs mched rnams la chu 'thung gi lung dang*/ sba bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa mang du bstan te phan pa 'ga' re tsam gyis mnyes par byas so/ /gnas bzang po 'dir sgyu lus ma bor ba la dge sbyor kho na la brtson pa cher byed dgos snyam na'ang*/ bla ma kha rag pa bya ba chos 'brel yod pa zhig gi gsung nas/ cis kyang yar phyogs la phyin pa 'thad pas 'dengs gsung nas stod phyogs la 'ongs shing*/

chu bo rir bla ma shākya shes rab sku gshegs pa'i pur dang mjal tsam zha ི ga byung*/ de dus bka' drin dran pas gdung gi drung du zhag bcu gcig gi bar la gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad pas/ nges 'byung dang skyo shas drag po zhig skyes te/ stod rtse 'am/ lho mon sogs dge sbyor 'phel ba/ dka' thub dang bcud len gyi rdzas mang la chu bzang sa gcig tu 'gro dgos bsam tsa na/ grogs mched mang po zhig lho mon la 'byon zer bas/ de rnams dang lhan cig tu zang zing cha ci yod rnams lhan du za la/ dge sbyor yang mnyam du byed cing skyid sdug ci byung bsre ba yin zer ba kha 'cham du byas te phyin pa las/ mon khar slebs dus sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa'i 'dun pa dang cung zad bral te/ grogs mched la la dngos po kho na'i ched du song*/ re zhig chos 'don dang rim gro 'dra byed du song ste/ dgun lo der nga rang gcig pus bum thang rgya le mkhar bya ba'i brag la sgrub pa kho na byed kyin bsdad/ de nas mon nub phyogs snga long bya bar phyin pas nags dang sa rnams na re/ bla ma gu ru bzang po yin zer bas/ gu ru'i ming du grags/ de'i dus gson po'i dge ba 'bul ba la/ rta dang*/ stag gzig dang*/ nas dang 'bras la sogs pa mang po byung zhing*/ bla ma dam pa kun mkhyen pa bum thang du phebs zer ba'i snyam grags che ba la brten te/ /mjal du 'gro bsam pa'i 'dun pa skyes pa la/ mon yul nub phyogs pa rnams kyis bsod nams dang dge ba yang 'phel du bsgyur pa dang*/ bdag gi dad pa'i gdung shugs ma log pa la brten nas/ snga long du phyags phebs/ yul de na 'khrug pa chen po yod cing*/ mi 'i gshis spyod shin tu rtsu ba pa las med na'ang*/ chos rje'i drud du mjal du phyin pas/ chos rje'i gsung gis yul khams 'di na g.yul ngo drag po yod dam gsung*/ nang 'khrug byed cing gda' lags zhus shing*/

nged kyi sa tshes bcu gcig gi nyin 'degs pas/ thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ yul khams na 'khrug longs chen po 'dug pas/ mi mang po 'dus nas 'khrug rtsod 'byung dogs yod gsung pas nged kyi grong dpon rnams kyi sar phyin nas 'khrug pa mi yong pa'i gnya' byed lags/ kho rang rnams la yang 'bul ba ci yod khyer shog zer ba byas pas chog lags zer ba zhus te/ gong bzhin du mi rnams la gnya' khrigs rnams byas nas 'dam sa lha khang bya ba'i nags chen po gcig tu tshes bcu mdzad de/ de'i zhabs tog rnams bsgrubs shing*/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi spyad pa rnams phul nas dges par mdzad do/ / yul khams de'i mi skya pho mo ma lus pa 'dus pas 'bul ba rta dang gser g.yu dar ras 'bras nas la sogs dpag tu med pa phul/ de nyin 'khrug rtsod med cing*/ 'gro ba rnams thar pa'i sa la 'god par mdzad/ de'i dus nged kyi phyi la 'dengs gsungs nas/ mon me na log kun bzang gling du phebs dus snying thig gi khrid gsungs te/ khrid pa shin tu mang ba zhig gi spros bcas kyi dbang bzhi byas/ khrid rjes gnang dang bcas pa thugs la btags te gnang*/ o rgyan gling bya ba'i dgon chung zhig chos rjes btab nas 'dir sdod gsungs pas bka' ma chog par lo gcig gi bar la bsdad*/ bum thang du gshegs dus 'dir yang bsdad par mi 'thad par 'dug 'dengs gsungs pas/ de nas bzung nas phyags phyir 'brengs shing lus ngag gi zhabs tog rang sems kyis ma khrel bar bsgrubs shing*/ bod kyi gdan 'dren rim par byung bas/ bod la phyags 'degs pa'i phyags phyi la lus dang grib ma bzhin du byas te/ dbang khrid kyi gdams pa bcas pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i man ngag spya ི dang bye brag tu gyur pa rnams rdzogs par gnang ste/ 'bri gung du phyags phebs/ zhwa padma dbang chen gyi gtsug lag khang la dkar me cod pan sogs kyi mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/

de dus snyung gzhi dum gcig byung ba la brten nas/ zhal chems la sogs pa'i yig rigs sogs kyang mdzad de/ mchims phur 'gro gsung ba la ston so mchims phur phyag phebs/ khrid pa shin tu mang ba zhig 'dzom ste khrid kyi sgang la song dus/ chos rje nyid gdod ma'i dbyings su sku 'pho ba'i tshul bstan te/ rjes kyi gshegs rdzongs/ khrid 'phro la sogs pa rnams dang*/ phyi rten nang rten/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi dus su mchod pa dang bcas pa bsgrubs shing*/ mchims phu rin po che'i gnas de nyid du/ ri nas mi 'beb dam bcas te sgrub pa'i mchod pas bla ma mnyes par bya snyam pa la/ bla ma de nyid kyi 'phrin las rnam par dag pa dang*/ sngon gyi las smon dag pa'i 'phen pas/ res 'ga' chos rje'i phyag srol/ gzhan don la dmigs te don gnyer gyi slob ma rnams la khrid ka re tsam bstan/ res 'ga' rang don gyi sgrub pa lo re tsam yang byas la/ bar skabs rnams su yang sos dal dang le lor ma bsdad par/ chos kyi rjes rgyal mtshan dam pa 'khon sa skya pa 'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nam rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ dus 'khor/ sbyor drug gnyis/ dmar khrid/ sems bskyed chen mo/ brtag gnyis/ gzer lnga sman dpyad ma/ gshed dmar lha lnga ma'i rdzogs rim spros med kyi khrid/ lha bcu gsum ma'i rdzogs rim/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i khrid rnams zhus/ bla ma shākya ratna las sbyor drug ston pa lugs/ bde mchog lus dkyil/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ bla ma bungngha shrī las/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gu ru tshe brtan gyi skor/ bla ma blo gros pa las sel dang bcas/ nā ro chos drug 'chi med/ lam 'bras 'khrul 'khor kye rdor kyi bka'/ 'jigs

byed lha bcu gsum ma/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i bka' bskyed rdzogs dang bcas pa/ gshed dmar lha lnga ma'i bka'/ lha bcu gsum ma'i bka'/ rnam sras rta brgyad ma'i bka' rjes gnang dang bcas pa zhus/ de ltar lus ngag yid gsum la rang don gyi 'khris med par byas te/ ngam shod lho byang sa cha stod smad kyi dad pa cung zad thob pa rnams thar pa'i lam sna tsam la bkod cing*/ zang zing gi dngos po than thun byung pa rnams rang gzhan tshogs bsags par bya ba'i ched du/ jo bo mched gnyis kyi thog drangs pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten lha sa/ bsam yas na bzhugs pa rnams la gser chab dkar me cod pan bsam yas sde dgon na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun chos byed kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams la tshogs 'khor 'bul nod la sogs pa bsgrubs shing*/ mdor na nad kyis gtses pa'i nyams thag pa gcig yan chad la phan pa'i bsam pas zin par byas te/ dad mos kyi sa la 'khod pa tsam du byas la bdag ma gtogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams ni rig 'dzin gyi bla ma dngos su byon pa yin zhing*/ bdag lta bu'i gang zag gis rjes su dpag par mi nus kyang*/ bshes gnyen dam pa shes rab rgya mtsho yis/ / gus pa'i tshul gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ /bsam yas mchims phur dpal gyi ri khrod du/ /spro ba'i sems kyis mdo tsam brjod pa la/ /nongs pa mchis gang mkhas rnams bzod par gsol/ /dge ba de yis mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun/ /zab yang rdo rje'i rtse mor rab phyin te/ /gdod ma'i sa la gtan srid zin par shog / bla ma dam pa 'od gsal rang grol gyi rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa/ phyi rabs kyi don du bkor pa re zhig rdzogs so/ / dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (4)rin po che 'od gsal rang grol gyi rnam par thar pa/ -PAGE 238--PAGE 239--PAGE 236-
